ticker_news.title: Everyone Thinks Adobe Will Suffer from AI. Here's Why It Could Thrive Instead
ticker_news.description: Despite analyst concerns about AI disruption, Adobe is experiencing record revenue and earnings growth, successfully integrating AI into its products and maintaining strong market performance.
ticker_news.author: William Dahl

ticker_news.title: 65% of Developers Expect Their Roles To Be Redefined by AI in 2026
ticker_news.description: A survey of 501 developers reveals AI is transforming software development, with 7 in 10 developers improving technical skills, half reporting better work-life balance, and senior developers expecting significant role redefinition in 2026.
ticker_news.author: Nacho De Marco

ticker_news.title: Up by About 2,000% in the Past Year, Is Rigetti Computing Stock a Buy?
ticker_news.description: Rigetti Computing, a quantum computing startup, has seen massive stock gains of 2,000% in the past year, but faces significant challenges in developing commercially viable quantum computing technology, with potential market readiness not expected until 2040.
ticker_news.author: Will Ebiefung

ticker_news.title: Is Quantum Computing Stock IonQ Headed to $60? History Offers a Clear Warning About What Could Happen Next
ticker_news.description: IonQ, a quantum computing company, has seen its stock surge 300% in the past year, but the article warns of potential overvaluation and unsustainable growth driven by equity issuances and acquisitions rather than organic revenue.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco
